name_ar: مزامنة ذاكرة التعليمات دون تضخم مع تحقق مستقل
name_en: Non-growth instruction-memory sync with independent verify
what: توليد مهارة مزامنة ذاكرة محلية تقارن CLAUDE.md والقواعد وملفات الوكلاء بالشيفرة، فتصلح الحقائق القديمة أولاً ثم تزيل التكرار وتضغط دون أن يكبر أي ملف، مع وكلاء تحقق مستقلين. — Generate a project-local memory-sync skill that diffs CLAUDE.md, rules and agent files against the code, repairs stale facts first, then dedups and compresses so no file grows, with separate verifier agents re-checking every edit.
when: CLAUDE.md or rules drifted from the code; too much always-loaded context; after a branch or commit range changed behavior; requests like 'sync memory', 'slim context', 'clean up agent config'.
how: 1) Resolve the mode (status|install|upgrade|...|purge) from the prompt; print a PLAN block; ask only if destructive. 2) Enumerate the memory surface by command; split into disjoint batches. 3) GATHER: read-only agents list change facts for the scope (session|branch|commit|all). 4) SYNC: one bounded agent per batch, all spawned in one message; facts first, dedup second, compression third; every file ends at or below its line count. 5) VERIFY: a different read-only agent per edited batch re-checks each fact in code and that removed facts are gone. 6) HARD depth: audit rule path globs (TOO_BROAD/TOO_NARROW/DANGLING/MISSING) and purge what a model already knows. 7) Report in chat only.

name_ar: إعداد تقرير TPAR للمقاولين في أستراليا
what: يعد تفصيل TPAR السنوي بتحديد المقاولين وفحص ABN وفصل ضريبة GST وتسجيل الأخطاء في ورقة عمل. — Prepare an annual TPAR breakdown: identify reportable contractors, validate ABNs, split GST and log errors in a working paper.
when: Australian client in a reportable industry needs the contractor payments report.
how: 1) Pull a full year of supplier bills and direct payments. 2) Filter by reportable industries (construction, cleaning, courier, IT, road freight, security); mixed businesses apply the 10% of GST turnover test. 3) Validate ABN: 11 digits plus check digit. 4) Separate GST; report gross. 5) Aggregate per contractor (gross, GST, net, count, first/last date). 6) Error sweep: missing ABN, duplicates, employees in AP, materials-only. 7) Word working paper; deadline 28 August.
